Bettina, I saved the draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". Nothing has been sent. It includes Sofia's bullets plus two new lines: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

I also need to correct my last message to Sofia. I said her draft was in her mailbox, but the draft tool saves to the mailbox of the account it runs as, which is mine (assistant). So both drafts are in my mailbox, not in Sofia's. If you want it in Sofia's name, she will need to copy it into her own mail or send it from her account.
